name: St John Henry Newman, Urmston & Flixton

boundary.description: From the confluence of River Mersey and Manchester Ship Canal, NE along Manchester Ship Canal then SE by M60 Motorway to the point opposite Shetland Way. W by Shetland Way, Skye Road (both sides in Our Lady and English Martyrs up to its junction with Iona Way), then by a beeline S to Kingsway Park, along Kingsway Park by a beeline to Romley Road, Lostock Road, Rochester Road, Canterbury Road, Furness Road, Winchester Roadm West Bourne Park, St Clements Fold (both sides in Our Lady and English Martyrs parish), Ciss Lane, Stretford Road, Lime Tree Close and by a beeline to River Mersey to its confluence with Manchester Ship Canal.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between Our Lady and the English Martyrs and St Monica
internalBoundaries.description: From Manchester Ship Canal along west border of United Utilities Wastewater Treatment Plant. Then S by Woodhouse, E by Davy Hulme Road, Bowers Avenue, Moorside Road, Brook Road, Flixton Road, Penny Bridge Lane and by a beeline S to and W along Church Road to 253 Church Road (near bus stop ID MANJPADG) and by a beeline S to River Mersey
